Q9024.reason: If the jury believes the suspect, the nightstick beating for mere cursing was excessive force and his punch was self-defense, which remains available even though the arrest itself was lawful.

Q9025.reason: Zoning compliance is not a complete defense, and a house that would destroy an existing solar use when it could be sited elsewhere is an unreasonable private nuisance, so the categorical judgment for the neighbor should be reversed.

Q9027.reason: Civil law is the body of law that establishes rights between persons and provides remedies when those rights are violated.
